variant: Bergmönch's hooded giant monk form with white hair and fiery plate-sized eyes in an underground mine.
aura: Dangerous imposing supernatural mine guardian, stern and just but frightening.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic folklore encyclopedia illustration of the German Bergmönch ('mountain monk'). The defining form is a GIANT WHITE-HAIRED spirit in a BLACK HOODED MONK'S COWL with TWO ENORMOUS FIERY EYES. Show the towering humanoid monk filling an old timber-supported mine gallery. Both eyes must be visibly far larger than ordinary human eyes: huge glowing circular amber-red eyes like dinner plates dominating a broad shadowed face, equal in size and fully readable beneath the hood. Long WHITE HAIR escapes the cowl at both sides. Two arms and two legs, full body enclosed in a plain black monk robe; height dwarfing the mine timbers conveys giant size. Faint ore veins and a small mine lantern provide setting. Menacingly stern watchful presence, deep cavern shadows and fierce eye light suggest an unpredictable guardian of miners. No victims, battle, gore or fire attack. Preserve monk form only, no horse/miner hybrid, horns, wings, skull face, beard replacing white hair, fantasy armor or weapons. Whole main silhouette and hood within the square, no text, symbols, lettering, borders or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation of the documented hooded giant variant.
